description: Cancel a booking. It stays in the system (visible with includeCanceled) but frees its seats. The account's cancellation policy is NOT applied, so no cancellation fee is charged. Bookeo: DELETE /bookings/{bookingNumber}.

cancelRemainingSeries.description: If part of a recurring series, also cancel all following bookings.

notifyCustomer.description: Email the customer about the cancellation.

reason.description: Why — included in the customer's cancellation email, if sent.

trackInCustomerHistory.description: Count this in the customer's cancellation stats.

name: bookeo_cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
